smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: MoldaSpace
shortDescription: Turns a floor plan, sketch, or photo into a photoreal render. Creator is $19 a month.
longDescription: MoldaSpace takes a photo, a floor plan, a sketch, or a 3D export and returns a photoreal render. Creator is $19 a month for 50 credits. Studio is $99 a month for 300 credits. Scale is $499 a month for 2,000 credits. A one-time pack is $6 for 10 credits or $19 for 40 credits. Eligible new accounts get 5 free credits and no card is required. A 2K generation uses 1 credit and a 4K generation uses 2.
